title: A‘udhu billah and Bismillah
intro: Two short sentences we say before every good thing we do.

learn.label: A‘udhu billah
learn.en: I seek Allah’s protection from the accursed Shaytan.

learn.label: Bismillah
learn.en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

learn.text: How we start every good deed

learn.html: We begin all our good and blessed deeds by saying A‘udhu billah and Bismillah.
When we say them, we ask Allah, the Most Merciful, to protect us and to give us His mercy. That is why we say them at many different times, for example:

items.label: In the morning and in the evening
When we travel – in a car or on a bike
When we play and have fun

options.why: We say Bismillah only before good deeds – never before something bad.
